  47 		var system: System = entry[0]

  61 	if not rooms.validate_graph(resources):

  80 func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
  81 	if event.is_echo():
  82 		return
  83 	for action in ACTIONS:
  84 		# Godot GUI handles menu focus and Enter. Escape has one runtime action.
  85 		if action.begins_with("ui_"):
  86 			continue
  87 		if event.is_action_pressed(action):
  88 			simulate_action(action, true)
  89 		elif event.is_action_released(action):
  90 			simulate_action(action, false)
  91 
  92 func simulate_action(action: String, pressed: bool) -> bool:
  93 	if not action in ACTIONS:
  94 		return false
  95 	_actions.append({"action": action, "pressed": pressed})
  96 	return true
  97 
  98 func take_actions() -> Array[Dictionary]:
  99 	var result: Array[Dictionary] = _actions
 100 	_actions = []
 101 	return result

 120 func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
 121 	if session == null:
 122 		return
 123 	tick_index += 1
 124 	_last_delta = delta
 125 	executed_groups.clear()
 126 	_run_group("input", delta)
 127 	var modal_pending: bool = false
 128 	var ui: C_Input = world.entity_id_registry["session"].get_component(C_Input)
 129 	for action in ui.ui_actions + _session_actions:
 130 		if action in ["pause", "map", "title", "new_run", "continue_run", "retry"]:
 131 			modal_pending = true
 132 	if session.mode == "playing" and not modal_pending:
 133 		for group_name in ["ai", "boss", "combat", "movement", "damage", "interaction"]:
 134 			_run_group(group_name, delta)
 135 	elif session.loading and session.mode == "transition":
 136 		_run_group("movement", 0.0)
 137 		_run_group("damage", 0.0)
 138 	_run_group("progression", delta if session.mode == "playing" else 0.0)
 139 	_run_group("save", 0.0)
 140 	if session.mode == "playing" and not modal_pending:
 141 		_run_group("effects", delta)
 142 	schedule_flush()
 143 
 144 func _run_group(group_name: String, delta: float) -> void:
 145 	executed_groups.append(group_name)
 146 	ECS.process(delta, group_name)

 148 func schedule_flush() -> void:
 149 	if not _flush_scheduled:
 150 		_flush_scheduled = true
 151 		_deferred_flush.call_deferred()
 152 
 153 func _deferred_flush() -> void:
 154 	_flush_scheduled = false
 155 	if not is_inside_tree() or not is_instance_valid(world):
 156 		return
 157 	in_safe_flush = true
 158 	world.flush_command_buffers()
 159 	for entity_id in _removals:
 160 		var entity: Entity = world.entity_id_registry.get(entity_id)
 161 		if is_instance_valid(entity):
 162 			world.remove_entity(entity)
 163 		_pending_placements.erase(entity_id)
 164 		_placements.erase(entity_id)
 165 	_removals.clear()
 166 	_apply_room_transition()
 167 	var spawns: Array[Dictionary] = _spawns
 168 	_spawns = []
 169 	for request in spawns:
 170 		if request.room_id == session.room_id and request.epoch == room_epoch and session.mode == "playing":
 171 			factory.create_transient(request.archetype, request.room_id, request.fields)
 172 	_run_group("materialize", _last_delta)
 173 	_run_group("animation", _last_delta if session.mode == "playing" else 0.0)
 174 	_run_group("camera", _last_delta)
 175 	_run_group("ui", _last_delta)
 176 	in_safe_flush = false
 177 	if entry_mode == "title" and placements_complete():
 178 		announce_ready()

 180 func fail(message: String) -> void:
 181 	if session != null:
 182 		session.mode = "error"
 183 		session.loading = false
 184 		session.message = message
 185 	push_error(message)
 186 	runtime_failed.emit(message)

 188 func request_spawn(archetype: String, room_id: String, fields: Dictionary) -> String:
 189 	_spawn_serial += 1
 190 	var entity_id: String = "%s:%s:%d" % [room_id, archetype, _spawn_serial]
 191 	var payload: Dictionary = fields.duplicate(true)
 192 	payload["id"] = entity_id
 193 	_spawns.append({"archetype": archetype, "room_id": room_id, "fields": payload, "epoch": room_epoch})
 194 	schedule_flush()
 195 	return entity_id

 205 func get_entity_snapshot(entity_id: String) -> Dictionary:
 206 	var entity: Entity = world.entity_id_registry.get(entity_id)
 207 	if not is_instance_valid(entity):
 208 		return {}
 209 	var result: Dictionary = {"id": entity.id, "enabled": entity.enabled}
 210 	var transform: C_Transform = entity.get_component(C_Transform)
 211 	if transform != null:
 212 		result.position = transform.position
 213 	var health: C_Health = entity.get_component(C_Health)
 214 	if health != null:
 215 		result.merge({"health": health.current, "max_health": health.maximum, "dead": health.dead, "hurt_left": health.hurt_left, "invulnerable_left": health.invulnerable_left, "team": health.team})
 216 	var combat: C_Combat = entity.get_component(C_Combat)
 217 	if combat != null:
 218 		result.merge({"energy": combat.energy, "max_energy": combat.max_energy, "attack_state": combat.state, "attack_serial": combat.attack_serial, "sword_cooldown": combat.sword_cooldown, "card_cooldown": combat.card_cooldown, "dodge_cooldown": combat.dodge_cooldown, "dodge_invulnerable": combat.dodge_invulnerable})
 219 	var boss: C_Boss = entity.get_component(C_Boss)
 220 	if boss != null:
 221 		result.merge({"phase": boss.phase, "boss_state": boss.state, "boss_time_left": boss.time_left, "phase_changed": boss.phase_changed, "attack_index": boss.attack_index, "arena_active": boss.arena_active, "slam_center": boss.slam_center})
 222 	var effect: C_Effect = entity.get_component(C_Effect)
 223 	if effect != null:
 224 		result.merge({"effect_kind": effect.kind, "remaining": effect.remaining, "duration": effect.duration, "effect_size": effect.size})
 225 	var interaction: C_Interaction = entity.get_component(C_Interaction)
 226 	if interaction != null:
 227 		result.merge({"interaction_kind": interaction.kind, "prompt": interaction.prompt, "selected": interaction.selected, "available": interaction.available, "target_room": interaction.target_room, "target_spawn": interaction.target_spawn})
 228 	var ai: C_EnemyAI = entity.get_component(C_EnemyAI)
 229 	if ai != null:
 230 		result.merge({"enemy_kind": ai.kind, "ai_state": ai.state, "ai_time_left": ai.time_left})
 231 	var projectile: C_Projectile = entity.get_component(C_Projectile)
 232 	if projectile != null:
 233 		result.merge({"owner_id": projectile.owner_id, "remaining": projectile.remaining, "consumed": projectile.consumed, "previous_position": projectile.previous_position, "direction": projectile.direction})
 234 	var visual: C_Visual = entity.get_component(C_Visual)
 235 	if visual != null:
 236 		result.merge({"animation": visual.animation, "visual_kind": visual.kind, "tint": visual.tint, "visual_offset": visual.offset})
 237 		if visual.node is AnimatedSprite2D:
 238 			result.frame = visual.node.frame
 239 	return result

 251 	result.merge(get_entity_snapshot(player.id), true)

 254 func get_run_snapshot() -> Dictionary:
 255 	var enemies: Array[Dictionary] = []
 256 	var projectiles: Array[Dictionary] = []
 257 	var bosses: Array[Dictionary] = []
 258 	var interactions: Array[Dictionary] = []
 259 	var effects: Array[Dictionary] = []
 260 	if is_instance_valid(world):
 261 		for entity in world.query.with_all([C_EnemyAI]).enabled().execute():
 262 			if entity.enabled:
 263 				enemies.append(get_entity_snapshot(entity.id))
 264 		for entity in world.query.with_all([C_Projectile]).enabled().execute():
 265 			if entity.enabled:
 266 				projectiles.append(get_entity_snapshot(entity.id))
 267 		for entity in world.query.with_all([C_Boss]).enabled().execute():
 268 			if entity.enabled:
 269 				bosses.append(get_entity_snapshot(entity.id))
 270 		for entity in world.query.with_all([C_Interaction]).enabled().execute():
 271 			if entity.enabled:
 272 				interactions.append(get_entity_snapshot(entity.id))
 273 		for entity in world.query.with_all([C_Effect]).enabled().execute():
 274 			if entity.enabled:
 275 				effects.append(get_entity_snapshot(entity.id))
 276 	var light: Color = Color.WHITE
 277 	for entity in world.query.with_all([C_Visual, C_RoomMember]).enabled().execute():
 278 		if entity.enabled and entity.get_component(C_Visual).asset_id == room_data.get("background", ""):
 279 			light = entity.get_component(C_Visual).tint
 280 			break
 281 	var scene_state: Dictionary = {"background": room_data.get("background", ""), "light": light, "platforms": room_data.get("platforms", []).duplicate(true), "door_count": room_data.get("doors", []).size(), "transition_pending": session.loading if session != null else true}
 282 	return {"scene_state": scene_state, "moonstep": progression.moonstep if progression != null else false, "visited_rooms": progression.visited_rooms.duplicate() if progression != null else [], "boss_defeated": progression.boss_defeated if progression != null else false, "ending_seen": progression.ending_seen if progression != null else false, "checkpoint": {"id": checkpoint.checkpoint_id, "room_id": checkpoint.room_id, "spawn_id": checkpoint.spawn_id, "valid": checkpoint.valid} if checkpoint != null else {}, "save_status": session.save_status if session != null else "none", "objective": session.objective if session != null else "", "room_epoch": room_epoch, "bosses": bosses, "interactions": interactions, "effects": effects, "mode": session.mode if session != null else "loading", "room_id": session.room_id if session != null else "", "room_name": room_data.get("name", ""), "loading": session.loading if session != null else true, "message": session.message if session != null else "", "tick": tick_index, "entity_count": world.entities.size() if is_instance_valid(world) else 0, "system_count": world.systems.size() if is_instance_valid(world) else 0, "groups": executed_groups.duplicate(), "pending_placements": _pending_placements.size(), "landing_count": landing_count, "camera_position": camera.position if is_instance_valid(camera) else Vector2.ZERO, "room_bounds": room_bounds, "player": get_player_snapshot(), "enemies": enemies, "projectiles": projectiles}

 292 # Bounded ordinary menu requests. These share the session queue used by UI controls.
 293 func request_session_action(action: String) -> bool:
 294 	if not action in ["new_run", "continue_run", "retry", "resume", "title", "pause", "map"]:
 295 		return false
 296 	_session_actions.append(action)
 297 	return true
 298

 313 func clear_gameplay_input() -> void:
 314 	_actions.clear()
 315 	for system in world.systems:
 316 		if system is InputSystem:
 317 			system.clear_actions()
 318 	for entity in world.query.with_all([C_Input]).enabled().execute():
 319 		if not entity.enabled:
 320 			continue
 321 		var input: C_Input = entity.get_component(C_Input)
 322 		input.axis = 0.0
 323 		input.jump_pressed = false
 324 		input.jump_held = false
 325 		input.sword_pressed = false
 326 		input.card_pressed = false
 327 		input.dodge_pressed = false
 328 		input.interact_pressed = false
 329 		input.ui_actions.clear()
 330 		var motion: C_Motion = entity.get_component(C_Motion)
 331 		if motion != null:
 332 			motion.buffer_left = 0.0
 333 	for entity in world.query.with_all([C_Interaction]).enabled().execute():
 334 		if not entity.enabled:
 335 			continue
 336 		entity.get_component(C_Interaction).selected = false
 337 		var body: C_Body = entity.get_component(C_Body)
 338 		if body != null and is_instance_valid(body.root):
 339 			var prompt: Label = body.root.get_node_or_null("InteractionPrompt")
 340 			if prompt != null:
 341 				prompt.visible = false
 342 
 343 func discard_transients() -> void:
 344 	_spawns.clear()
 345 	_projectile_contacts.clear()
 346 	for entity in world.query.with_any([C_Projectile, C_Hitbox, C_Effect]).execute():
 347 		request_removal(entity.id)

 349 func _apply_room_transition() -> void:
 350 	if session.mode != "transition" or session.transition.is_empty() or session.transition.get("applied", false):
 351 		return
 352 	var request: Dictionary = session.transition
 353 	var next: Dictionary = rooms.load_room(request.room_id, resources)
 354 	if next.is_empty() or not next.spawns.has(request.spawn_id):
 355 		fail("Invalid room transition")
 356 		return
 357 	room_epoch += 1
 358 	_spawns.clear()
 359 	_removals.clear()
 360 	_placements.clear()
 361 	_pending_placements.clear()
 362 	_projectile_contacts.clear()
 363 	for entity in world.query.with_all([C_RoomMember]).execute():
 364 		if not entity.get_component(C_RoomMember).persistent:
 365 			world.remove_entity(entity)
 366 	room_data = next
 367 	var bounds: Array = next.bounds
 368 	room_bounds = Rect2(bounds[0], bounds[1], bounds[2], bounds[3])
 369 	session.room_id = next.id
 370 	player.get_component(C_RoomMember).room_id = next.id
 371 	factory.create_room(next)
 372 	var spawn: Array = next.spawns[request.spawn_id]
 373 	request_placement(player.id, Vector2(spawn[0], spawn[1]))
 374 	player.get_component(C_Motion).placement_pending = true
 375 	session.transition.applied = true
 376 
 377 func can_continue() -> bool:
 378 	return not save_repository.read_save(rooms, resources).is_empty()
